g.aria-label: Pitfall: Zero Gate Bias Starts with a 1-Step Memory Horizon
At initialization W ≈ 0, b_f = 0 ⇒ f_t = σ(0) = 0.5 (τ_1/2 = 1 step!)
After T − 1 steps, gradient ∂c_T / ∂c_1 = (0.5)^T-1 vanishes before learning starts
Fix: Initialize b_f > 0 (or log-uniform in [1, T_max]) so gates start open at Step 0
